findings.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway Security Bulletin (CTX697305)
findings.summary_md: Vendor bulletin, with the changelog recording initial publication on 2026-11-12 and no time of day given on the page; it lists 28 CVEs against NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, with CVE-2026-107412 the only one at CVSS v4.0 9.5 (AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H), described as multiple memory overflow vulnerabilities, CWE-119, that lead to unpredictable or erroneous behavior and denial of service. Precondition is a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or an AAA virtual server, testable with the config patterns add vpn vserver and add authentication vserver. Fixed builds are 14.1-73.57, 13.1-64.39, 14.1-FIPS 14.1-73.58 and 13.1-FIPS/NDcPP 13.1-37.293, and Secure Private Access Hybrid deployments on NetScaler instances are also affected. Credits list Michael Tucker and Chew Keong Tan of the XOR team at JPMorgan Chase, Kyle Hannon of CapitalOne Offensive Security, and Himanshu Anand and Sina Kheirkhah of watchTowr, plus Cloud Software Group Product Security Team findings from AI-assisted code analysis.

findings.title: Security Advisory 2026-020: Critical Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
findings.summary_md: CERT-EU advisory 2026-020, release date printed on the page as 12-11-2026 17:20:53 Brussels time (UTC+1 in November, hence 16:20:53Z). It states that on 12 November 2026 Cloud Software Group published bulletins covering 28 memory flaws in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, that CVE-2026-107412 (CVSS 9.5) affects appliances configured as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN or RDP Proxy) or an AAA virtual server and can be reached without authentication according to the vendor, and that CVE-2026-120868 (CVSS 9.3) affects every deployment including the default configuration. It records that Citrix reports no exploitation and that no public proof of concept has been confirmed, notes ten of the flaws are scored high on confidentiality, integrity and availability while the vendor describes the impact only as unpredictable behavior or denial of service, and recommends upgrading internet-facing Gateway and AAA appliances first. Affected versions listed are 14.1 before 14.1-73.57, 13.1 before 13.1-64.39, ADC FIPS before 14.1-73.58 FIPS, and ADC FIPS/NDcPP before 13.1-37.293.

findings.title: Citrix Patches 12 NetScaler and Secure Access Client Flaws, Including Authentication Bypass
findings.summary_md: The Hacker News coverage by Ravie Lakshmanan, dated Nov 12, 2026 (no time of day on the page). First trade write-up of the batch: it lists the NetScaler ADC and Gateway CVEs including CVE-2026-107412 at CVSS 9.5 for Gateway or AAA virtual server deployments and CVE-2026-120868 at 9.3 for all deployments, and gives the fixed builds 14.1-73.57, 13.1-64.39, 14.1-73.58 FIPS and 13.1-37.293. It also covers NetScaler Console CVE-2026-120869, a 9.4 authentication bypass fixed in NetScaler Console 14.1-74.34, and Secure Access Client privilege escalation CVE-2026-118268 (Windows, 26.11.1.6) and CVE-2026-118269 (Linux, 26.10.4). Citrix said it is not aware of any exploits for the announced vulnerabilities and described a deeper codebase review using AI-assisted code analysis.
